params: How high she rises at the top of each hop, in pixels. She is hopping over the plant, not along a row, so even the low end is a real leap; the high end sends her up among the leaves at the top of the frame.
How long she floats over the plant. Zero crosses the gap at one steady speed; high launches hard, hangs above the fruit, then drops onto the far side.
How far her head drives into the fruit on each strike, in pixels. The violence of a single peck. It is the same on both sides.
How hard she shakes her head side to side while tearing flesh off the fruit, in pixels.
How many juice, seed and pulp particles each bite throws. The size of the mess she leaves behind her.
The pull on the juice she throws off. Low leaves it hanging in the air; high drops it straight into the soil.
How the stripped plant leaves, back the way she came. Zero drags it off at a constant speed; high whips it away under her and lets the last of it coast out of frame.
